description: A Sissoo practitioner's public profile by practitioner id (from search results): name, place, session languages, service types and their bookable sessions, with a link to their Sissoo page. Practitioners' phone numbers, emails and addresses are private on Sissoo, so don't look them up elsewhere: people contact a practitioner through their Sissoo page.

currency.description: Currency for prices: GBP (default), EUR, USD or AUD.

id.description: Practitioner id from search results, e.g. "joyspace-therapy".

lang.description: Language of titles and booking pages: en, de, fr, es, it or pt. Default: the user's locale, else en.

name: get_practitioner

as_of.description: When the free times were last refreshed.

more_sessions.description: Further sessions on their Sissoo page.

services.description: Up to 10 sessions, soonest free first.

id.description: Service id for get_service and next_free_times.

start.description: Start, ISO 8601 with the UK offset.

place.description: City and country for in-person sessions; null when online only.

text.description: Price with the booking fee included, or "free".

session_languages.description: Two-letter codes of the languages the session is held in.

stages.description: Sissoo's 3 E's, where a client is with this kind of session: emerge alone = a first step for someone new to it; evolve alone = for going deeper (series, programmes, follow-ups); both = open to anyone; empower = community or guiding others. Empty until Sissoo has sorted it.

url.description: Service page on sissoo.com, with the next free day picked.

title: Sissoo practitioner
